scope: Actual source functions/classes and real Three.js, with explicit fixture boundaries; test-only unsafe candidates are never shipped

controls.reason: An escaped Array alias cannot be repaired by a getter on the pool; preserving immediate dense membership requires compaction before that observation.
The issue protects the remaining pts[0], but earlier published sample points and the samples Array itself can also remain referenced.
No mutation version exists for the exposed Float32Array. Checking the old winner alone cannot observe a different slot becoming oldest.
Registration participates in global eviction; retaining RNG consumption alone does not preserve visible pool output. No guaranteed future multi-camera visibility contract exists.

FXHooks.seenBeams is a lifetime WeakSet keyed by the record. Native flights also retain job.beam, and transport adds _netPeer/_netBorn/_netBornTick/_netOwner/_netSteps beyond the four proposed fields.

Same render timestamp does not establish roster stability. Beam output also applies alpha discard and tone mapping before additive blend; multiplying pre-shader alpha is not a proven pixel-equivalent coalescing rule.
The null field is a release convention, not evidence that a debugger/callback has released an old flight/vector reference. No non-escape ownership capability exists for this field.
Actual installed movement/resolve wrappers and native sphere/stand sweep, with a synchronous stand birth in the delegated movement; zero-at-entry is not zero-until-resolve.
Stand pose, expiry, retirement, roster and Tower axes are mutable without a shared revision. The original per-query live scan is retained until all writers can provide trustworthy invalidation.
The real target probe delegates to mutable ground/resolve behavior. No authenticated static collision epoch is exposed; matching coordinates or query stamp cannot authorize reuse.

The actual fit body can match all three immediately measured nodes while changing other synchronous consumers. Unlike bomb preview there is no enclosing whole-rig rollback transaction. Full traversal remains until guarded downstream equivalence and device benefit are established.
